purpose: Implements a cyclic TSN-style scheduling system based on periodic slots. Provides mechanisms to define periodic transmission windows (Slot), expand them into occurrences, validate conflicts, compile schedules into graph annotations, and visualize schedules in static (matplotlib) and interactive (plotly) forms.

internal: Usecase (via from_usecase, update_streams, window_length, graph structure)

data_model.Slot: Represents a periodic transmission window for a stream on a specific port and queue. Includes start/end times, period, stream_id, port_id, optional port_name, and queue_id. Supports expansion into cyclic occurrences.
data_model.Schedule: A list-based container of Slot objects representing a cyclic schedule over a defined cycle_ns. Provides compilation into graph transmission windows and stream-level scheduling metadata.
data_model.TransmissionWindow: Non-periodic merged representation of slot occurrences per port. Contains start, duration, queue state encoding, and stream sequence metadata.

responsibilities: Define periodic time slots for TSN stream transmissions
Expand periodic slots into cycle-bound occurrences
Detect scheduling conflicts across expanded occurrences
Convert slot schedules into per-port transmission windows
Write scheduling results back into NetworkX graph (egress_ports)
Annotate streams with computed offsets, paths, and latency
Convert between compact encoding matrices and slot-based schedules
Provide static and interactive visualization of schedules

graph_interaction_model.input: NetworkX DiGraph with nodes containing egress_ports metadata including schedule and scheduleCycle
graph_interaction_model.output: Graph annotated with TransmissionWindow objects per port
side_effects: Sets basetime and scheduleCycle per port
Mutates stream objects with offset, pathLists, accLatency, and listener placements

encoding_formats.compact_encoding: 2D numpy array (ports × streams) storing start times (+1 offset encoding)
encoding_formats.TransmissionWindow: Merged non-periodic representation of overlapping slot occurrences per port
encoding_formats.schedule_cycle: Global cycle duration (cycle_ns) governing periodic expansion

visualization_modes: matplotlib static Gantt-style per-port schedule plot
plotly interactive timeline with stream-based grouping and hover metadata
algorithmic_characteristics: Periodic time expansion with modular arithmetic
Greedy merging of overlapping transmission windows
Per-port state encoding for queue-level scheduling
